item.title: 15 Aug — PIX/UPI one‑tap is the wedge
item.description:
## The one thing We should out‑execute on on‑ramps: instant PIX (Brazil) and UPI (India) deposits with a 30–60s “first stake” experience, soft autolimits, and equally smooth withdrawals. UPI and PIX now carry country‑scale daily volumes; if we make money movement a non‑event, our same books feel faster and safer.
